name: workbench
description: Thin fetch wrapper over the workbench HTTP API: one MCP tool `workbench__tool` taking {tool, params} and POSTing {"tool":..., "params":...} to base_url + tool_path (default http://workbench:8080). No business logic, no SDK, no state.

config_schema.label: Workbench Base URL
config_schema.description: Base URL of the workbench HTTP API (the compose service DNS name http://workbench:8080 inside the omni docker network; the dev overlay publishes host port 12347).

config_schema.label: Tool Path
config_schema.description: Path appended to base_url for a tool invocation; the request is POST {base_url}{tool_path} with body {"tool": <tool>, "params": <params>}.

config_schema.label: HTTP Timeout (s)
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one workbench call (AbortController); a timeout returns a clear isError result, never a hang.

config_schema.label: Authorization Header
config_schema.description: Optional Authorization header value (e.g. "Bearer $secret:WORKBENCH_TOKEN"). Empty = no Authorization header is sent.
